from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path.cwd().resolve()
protected = ['planner.py', 'test_planner.py', 'notes.txt']
snapshots = {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in protected}
status_before = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1'])
commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{commit}:planner.py'])
print('Before commit:', commit)
for name, data in snapshots.items():
    print(f'Original SHA-256 {name}: {hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}')
print('Working planner Git blob:', subprocess.check_output(['git', 'hash-object', 'planner.py'], text=True).strip())
runner = '''from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest
import planner
copy = Path.cwd().resolve()
origin = Path(planner.__file__).resolve()
assert origin.is_relative_to(copy), (origin, copy)
assert origin == copy / \"planner.py\", (origin, copy)
print(\"CONFIRMED planner.__file__:\", origin, flush=True)
unittest.main(module=None, argv=[\"unittest\", \"-v\", \"test_planner\"])
'''
paths = []
results = []
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='.planner-comparison-', dir=root) as scratch:
        scratch_path = Path(scratch)
        paths.append(scratch_path)
        for label, implementation in [('HEAD', head), ('WORKING', snapshots['planner.py'])]:
            copy = scratch_path / label.lower()
            copy.mkdir()
            (copy / 'planner.py').write_bytes(implementation)
            (copy / 'test_planner.py').write_bytes(snapshots['test_planner.py'])
            assert (copy / 'test_planner.py').read_bytes() == snapshots['test_planner.py']
            env = os.environ.copy()
            env.pop('PYTHONPATH', None)
            env['TMPDIR'] = str(copy)
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', runner], cwd=copy, env=env,
                                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
            print(f'\\n--- {label}: unchanged native unittest -v test_planner ---')
            print(result.stdout, end='')
            print(f'{label} exit code: {result.returncode}')
            results.append(result.returncode)
finally:
    for name, data in snapshots.items():
        assert (root / name).read_bytes() == data, f'Original changed: {name}'
        print(f'PRESERVED byte-for-byte: {name}')
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1']) == status_before
    assert all(not path.exists() for path in paths)
    print('Git status unchanged; owned comparison copies removed.')
assert results == [1, 0], results
PY"
